info.title: Folderit DMS
info.description: Folderit is a document management system (DMS) for organizing business documents. Find records, create folders, upload and download files, add document versions, read and update metadata, and queue configured document workflows using your Folderit permissions.

scopes.offline_access: Keep the connection working after the initial access token expires.

get.description: Lists up to one thousand accounts accessible to the signed in Folderit user.
Retrieves one account by its exact UID.
Lists the root folders and sections available in the selected account.

post.description: Creates a child folder or returns an existing folder under the exact parent.

parameters.name: X-Folderit-Request-Key
parameters.description: Audit correlation only. This is not an idempotency key.

returnDuplicateFolder.description: Return an existing same named folder in the exact parent.

get.description: Lists direct child folders of the selected folder.
Retrieves one folder by its exact UID.
Retrieves one file, folder, or data item by its exact UID.
Retrieves a file and its current version identity.
Lists direct children of a folder with explicit page bounds.
Lists versions of one existing file.

post.description: Searches records using the documented POST transport so filters are not lost.

parentUid.description: Exact folder UID to search inside.

offset.description: Offset within the initial result window.

get.description: Lists up to one thousand metadata definitions with exact UIDs and field types.
Reads metadata values while retaining their JSON types.

put.description: Validates single value scalar metadata before writing and verifies the resulting values.

parameters.name: X-Folderit-Request-Key
parameters.description: Audit correlation only. This is not an idempotency key.

fieldsJson.description: JSON array of objects with metaUid and value. Supports single value scalar fields only.

post.description: Uploads at most 10 MiB of file bytes using a create, PUT, and complete sequence. Disable action retries and deduplicate source events.

parameters.name: X-Folderit-Request-Key
parameters.description: Audit correlation only. This is not an idempotency key.

fileContent.description: File bytes as base64. Map file content from the source action.

post.description: Adds at most 10 MiB as a new version of the exact file. Disable automatic action retries.

parameters.name: X-Folderit-Request-Key
parameters.description: Audit correlation only. This is not an idempotency key.

fileContent.description: File bytes as base64. Map file content from the source action.

get.description: Downloads the current file as base64 bytes with MIME type, length, and hash. Processing responses require a later retry.

202.description: The file is still being prepared. Retry later.

get.description: Lists workflows and exact manual start options for this record.

post.description: Queues a selected manual workflow start. A queued result does not mean completion.

parameters.name: X-Folderit-Request-Key
parameters.description: Audit correlation only. This is not an idempotency key.

triggerId.description: Exact trigger ID returned by List startable workflows.

multiple.description: Whether the definition allows multiple values.

optionsJson.description: Select options as JSON, or an empty array.

valueJson.description: Value serialized as JSON, retaining its original type.

queued.description: True when the start request was queued, not finished.

versionAdded.description: Whether this upload added a version to an existing file.

fileContent.description: Base64 file bytes. Map directly to Folderit upload fileContent, or use base64ToBinary for a binary file action.

verified.description: Whether independent readback matched every submitted value.

mutationState.description: Write state when a result cannot be verified.
